scope: Campos sempre visíveis para digitar os totais exatos de escolas e estudantes na pergunta de desafios. Presets e detalhes opcionais preservados nas demais perguntas; faixas antigas não substituem os totais obrigatórios.

interface: School and student total inputs are directly visible on Challenges, with no range selection.
Blank exact totals disable Next even when legacy ranges were saved.
Typing 12345 schools and 1600000 students displays 12.345 and 1.600.000 in Portuguese and enables Next.
Challenge selections and optional notes from the previous delivery are preserved.
validation.network_input: Exact positive integer totals entered by the user; no estimated or range-based totals.

bamanankan: Nomes existentes preservados; introduções novas usam fallback inglês explícito, com aviso de tradução preliminar mantido.

interface: Before priority selection, navigation exposes only Context, Country and Priorities; no future stages, live procurement panel, matrix or calculator.
After AI governance selection, navigation reveals the institutional path. Direct access to dependent steps before priority selection returns to Priorities.
Governance diagnosis was completed with clicks only; visible text boxes counted zero. Suggestions for results reflect selected regulation and child-safety challenges.
Instruments, evidence types, owners, gaps, actions, resources, capacity and review use selection presets; free text is inside Add more information +.
Optional note remains in the plan when the selected situation changes; stored earlier free text is preserved.
Network ranges are selectable and do not become exact counts. Unknown cost, explicit zero and optional informed amounts remain distinct.

pdf.text: Selected labels, network ranges and optional synthetic note appear without internal option IDs or fabricated monetary totals.
pdf.visual: All eight pages rendered and inspected without overlap or clipping.

regressions: Preset IDs retain their meaning after challenge changes.
JSON round-trip preserves selections, custom notes and previous answers.
A governance case can answer every step by selecting options without typing, while unknown costs remain pending.
Selected option labels follow the current language; personal notes retain their text.

governance_translation_status: PT/EN/ES/FR new text; existing translations retained for AR/ZH/BM/ZU/SW, with explicit English entries for new text awaiting native review and the existing preliminary-translation notice.
governance_input_style: Selectable presets; Add more information + for optional details.
network_input: Exact positive integer totals entered by the user; no estimated or range-based totals.
cost_input: Unknown, explicit no cost, or optional informed amount; no monetary presets fabricated.
